title: A government's systems were breached by a lone operator and a team of AI agents - TCR 08/13/26
description:
Researchers say one operator and a cluster of AI agents compromised at least 85 accounts at an unnamed Asian government and reached a nuclear-safety agency and seven energy operators, Alibaba shipped a 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen to open weights as DeepSeek's V4 Pro hit general availability at sub-cent cached-input pricing, and a 40-minute poisoned build of the open-source tool LiteLLM drained credentials from more than 2,500 organizations including Microsoft, Amazon, and Samsung.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-13-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:37 Taiwan traces a state-scale breach to AI agents
3:36 The open-weight frontier fills in
7:12 LiteLLM compromise exposes 2,500 organizations
10:30 Labs operate like energy and finance firms
14:26 Close

This episode covers researchers' account of the first state-scale autonomous AI intrusion at an unnamed Asian government, the open-weight frontier filling in with Qwen, DeepSeek, NVIDIA Nemotron and Liquid AI, the LiteLLM supply-chain compromise, Anthropic's $9.1 billion Riot compute deal and OpenAI's power-trading hire, Twitch's AI-training opt-out, and an engineered probiotic that senses glucose and doses back in animal models.

Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs confirmed an AI-assisted attack but did not endorse researchers' separate account that open-source AI agents were assembled into an autonomous hacking tool that behaved like a coordinated team, compromising at least 85 accounts at an unnamed Asian government and exfiltrating 2,500-plus personnel records before Israeli firm Dream flagged the machine-speed tempo and defenders unwound it. The story's center of gravity, according to researchers' separate account, is that one human set the objective while the agents ran the tradecraft. That same class of capability arrived open the same window: a 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen in downloadable weights, DeepSeek V4 Pro at general availability, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for edge agents, and Liquid's LFM2.5-VL-3B running vision-language on a phone. Concentration is the exposure - a poisoned LiteLLM build drained credentials from 2,500-plus organizations in forty minutes, work a crew described as mostly teenagers took credit for. And the compute bill is coming due: Anthropic committed $9.1 billion to convert Riot's Texas Bitcoin campus, agreed to absorb consumer electricity-price increases in a Macquarie/GIC venture, and OpenAI is hiring a power-trading lead.
